title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
interest that when invitations were sent urging the former Savoy College students to attend the cornerstone laying of the Halsell Gymnasium, WPA project No. 2022, more than fifty ex-students of the old College were in attendance. Many others wrote letters expressing warm interest. The roster and the names of the forty-eight ex-students who did were copied from the official register and placed in the cornerstone with some relics of the College that had been brought for that purpose. The names of these appear in the roster on page 233.

Notice of a called meeting of former Savoy College ex-students following immediately after the cornerstone-laying program was placed on the program. That meeting was the first official group of ex-students to undertake plans for an all-college reunion. It set up a general committee on reunion plans, which began work immediately. The members of the committee were:

Mr. E. A. McMahon, Chairman
Mrs. J. B. May, Secretary
Mrs. Harlow Roberts

The cornerstone laying was observed with the following program:

1. Introductory, W. F. Carter, Chairman
2. Quartet, Mr. and Mrs. D. A. Abby, Joe Dodson and B. M. Nelson
